opportunity_brief.headline: Create a premium weeknight experience leveraging underutilized facilities.
opportunity_brief.opportunity: Design a premium experience package for weeknights that includes a stay at The Virelle Dublin, a fine dining experience at Solas Restaurant, and a relaxing session at the Vitalis Spa. This package targets couples and leisure travelers attending nearby events.

solution_spec.experience_name: The Virelle Dublin Night of Elegance
solution_spec.tagline: Indulge in a Night of Culinary and Spa Bliss
solution_spec.positioning_statement: A luxurious weeknight escape designed for couples and leisure travelers attending Dublin's vibrant events, offering an exquisite blend of fine dining and spa relaxation.
solution_spec.experience_concept: The Virelle Dublin Night of Elegance is a premium experience that combines the best of The Virelle's offerings. Guests will enjoy a Michelin-adjacent dining experience at Solas Restaurant, unwind with a rejuvenating session at the Vitalis Spa, and cap the night with signature cocktails at The Aerie Rooftop Bar, all while staying in the comfort of our Classic Room. This package is crafted for those who seek a seamless blend of relaxation and culinary delight amidst the bustling city events.
solution_spec.target_customer: Couples and leisure travelers attending events in Dublin who seek a premium, relaxing experience.

guest_journey.description: Guests are greeted with a welcome drink and escorted to their Classic Room.
Guests enjoy a six-course tasting menu with wine pairing.
Guests unwind with a 60-minute treatment of choice.
Guests enjoy signature cocktails at The Aerie Rooftop Bar.
Guests have breakfast delivered to their room.
Guests enjoy a leisurely checkout at noon.

package_components.description: Overnight stay in a Classic Room.
Six-course tasting menu with wine pairing.

pricing.pricing_rationale: The pricing is set between the City Uncovered (€495) and a premium offering, reflecting the combined value of dining, spa, and accommodation. Capacity aligns with room availability and facility utilisation.

service_requirements: Dedicated concierge for seamless guest experience coordination
Solas Restaurant staff for dinner service
Rooftop bar staff for cocktail service

campaign.positioning: This campaign positions The Virelle Dublin as the ultimate destination for an elegant escape, offering a seamless blend of relaxation and culinary delight that extends beyond the ordinary. It's not just a night; it's an experience that lingers in memory.
campaign.audience: Affluent couples seeking a luxurious midweek retreat amidst the bustling city events, who appreciate fine dining, spa indulgence, and exclusive experiences.

instagram.post: Step into a night where elegance never ends. Experience the Michelin-adjacent dining, rejuvenating spa treatments, and rooftop cocktails at The Virelle Dublin. #VirelleElegance #LuxuryInDublin

email.subject: Your Night of Elegance Awaits at The Virelle Dublin
email.preview: Indulge in a night of culinary and spa bliss with us.
email.body:
Dear [Name],

Escape the ordinary and immerse yourself in an evening of unparalleled elegance at The Virelle Dublin. Enjoy a Michelin-adjacent dining experience, a soothing spa session, and signature cocktails with a view—all while luxuriating in our Classic Room. Reserve your night of elegance now.

Warm regards,
Amelia Bennett
Brand & Growth Director, VIRELLE

messages.web: Indulge in a Night of Culinary and Spa Bliss at The Virelle Dublin. Reserve Now.

launch_schedule.action: Tease the experience on Instagram with a focus on visual storytelling of the Classic Room and Solas Restaurant.
Send an exclusive email invitation to our loyal guests and VIP list, highlighting the unique elements of the experience.
Launch a countdown on Instagram Stories, showcasing the spa and rooftop bar with engaging visuals.
Update the website banner with the campaign message and push a final call-to-action on Instagram and email.

campaign.call_to_action: Reserve your night of elegance at The Virelle Dublin.
campaign.campaign_rationale: This campaign leverages the unique combination of The Virelle's premium offerings to create an irresistible midweek escape. By targeting affluent couples and emphasizing the exclusivity and sophistication of the experience, we aim to convert unsold inventory into a memorable and commercially successful event.

agents.name: Alexander Sterling
agents.title: Executive Director

decision.decision_summary: The premium weeknight experience aligns with our strategic goals by converting unsold inventory into high-margin revenue. The campaign is well-positioned to attract affluent couples seeking luxury experiences.

evaluation.assessment: The package offers a strong margin of 61.9%, with a significant contribution to revenue from unsold inventory.
The hotel has sufficient available inventory to accommodate the expected sales, with 12 rooms available on the target nights.
The experience aligns with our luxury brand positioning, offering a sophisticated blend of dining and relaxation.

notes: Risk of not reaching full capacity due to midweek scheduling.
Mitigation through targeted marketing to affluent couples and leveraging city events.

decision.strategic_fit: The experience strategically leverages unsold inventory to enhance midweek revenue while reinforcing the hotel's luxury brand image.
decision.recommendation: Proceed with the launch of 'THE NIGHT DOESN'T END' campaign, focusing on targeted marketing and leveraging city events to maximize occupancy.
